findings.motion: SB 1174 Min Senate Third Reading By BERMAN, Assembly Floor, result PASS 57 to 16
findings.note: Voted no on the Assembly floor for SB 1174 (Elections: voter identification), which bars local governments from requiring voter ID. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

findings.motion: AB 1116 Berman Assembly Third Reading, Assembly Floor, result PASS 60 to 18
findings.note: Voted no on the Assembly floor for AB 1116 (online voter registration without a driver's license or state ID, using the last four digits of the Social Security number to verify identity). Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.
